display.title: Episode 541: Reb Asher the Melamed, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: A decree forbids teaching Torah to children, and the Baal Shem Tov chooses the absent-minded but devoted teacher Reb Asher to plead with the minister. Plus a boy's letter about helping the Rebbe.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in Av 5752. The show opens with a promotion for Tzivos Hashem's Summer Spectacular at the Monticello Raceway, then the Hakochainik march. A first-grade class from a Boro Park girls' school leads the Shema, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time begins 'Reb Asher the Melamed'. In the Baal Shem Tov's town lives Reb Asher, a teacher whose love for his pupils makes every lesson exciting, though he is so absorbed in teaching that his coat is buttoned wrong and his socks don't match. Then a government messenger announces that teaching Torah to Jewish children is forbidden. The town says Tehillim, and the rabbi asks the Baal Shem Tov for advice. To everyone's surprise the Baal Shem Tov chooses Reb Asher to go to the minister, and Reb Asher accepts joyfully. But the minister stares at him silently and has him handcuffed and led away. After Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery, Uncle Yossi reads a boy's letter: inspired by last week's letter, he has started giving tzedakah, saying the Twelve Pesukim and signing up friends for Tzivos Hashem, all in the merit of the Rebbe's recovery. The show ends with candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Trust the guidance of a tzaddik and trust Hashem, who guards Klal Yisrael; what counts is devotion, not appearances.

date.note: Promotes an event on 'Sunday evening, August 23rd' (a Sunday in 1992); Friday candle-lighting 7:37 matches 14 August 1992; the letter refers to episode 540's letter 'last week'.
